# Project Workspace Instructions

## Project Overview
Next.js application with Material UI, Iconify icons, and Axios for API calls. Features image upload functionality.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js (App Router)
- TypeScript
- Material UI
- Iconify
- Axios
- Firebase (Auth & Realtime Database)
- Gemini AI

## Development

Run development server:
```bash
npm run dev
```

Build for production:
```bash
npm run build
npm start
```
